source_text: Unusquisque cum universa domo: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Iudas. Ioseph erat in Aegypto uxoremque inde accepit, et in numero patriarcharum manet. Domus — generationes animae ingredientis mundum.
pass_a_gloss: Each with whole house: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah. Joseph was in Egypt and-wife from-there received, and in number of-patriarchs remains. Houses — generations of-soul entering world.
pass_b_english: Each with his whole house: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah. [[Joseph was in Egypt and took a wife from there >> Bible:Genesis 41:45; Exodus 1:5]], yet remains in the patriarchs’ number. The houses are generations of the soul entering the world.
